title: Utility Tariff Season Rollover Missing
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utilityrate:tariff
| stats max(_time) as last_update by provider season_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_update)/86400,1)
| where days_since>45
| sort - days_since
description: Uses Utility tariff exports telemetry to monitor whether seasonal tariff tables have been refreshed recently in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for stale rate schedules before cost reporting drifts, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Utility tariff exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Provider table of days since tariff update.
grandmaExplanation: It turns whether seasonal tariff tables have been refreshed recently so you can spot stale rate schedules before cost reporting drifts before it becomes annoying.
